source_evidence: The enum/name table includes mm1TangentU, mm1TangentV and mm0Intersection, but this only proves names exist; it does not prove selectable modes
FreeCAD enables only modes with non-empty modeRefTypes; empty modeRefTypes means enum/name entry is not selectable
TangentU/TangentV appear only as surface tangent calls inside mmTangentPlane; AttachEngineLine has no modeRefTypes or switch case for mm1TangentU/mm1TangentV
AttachEnginePoint registers Origin, CenterOfCurvature, OnEdge, Vertex, Focus, ProximityPoint and CenterOfMass; it has no modeRefTypes[mm0Intersection] and no case mm0Intersection
IntersectionLine is a DatumLine face-face straight-line route with FreeCAD source and cad-core support; it is not IntersectionPoint
